core_principle: Strategies are invoked as stage-internal micro-strategies. A micro-strategy may only update local OptIR fields and pass local checks. Full code-level and semantic verification is executed after the stage is complete.

micro_strategy_invocation.code_generation: optional local patch draft; full stage patch may be generated after stage plan is complete
micro_strategy_invocation.rollback_scope: subphase-level before stage patch is committed

stage_invocation.code_generation: stage-level patch generation after required fields are complete
